name: FWC Window Counter
description: Shows frame windows in game in real time (uses results from the FWC app)

enabled.name: Show window counter
enabled.description: Turn off to hide the panel, numbers and rings in game.

show-rings.name: Rings at click position
show-rings.description: Leave a colored ring and the window number where each click happened.

click-sounds.name: Click sounds
click-sounds.description: Plays a click sound on every press and release. To use your own sounds, put press.wav and release.wav in the mod config folder 'clicks'.

macro-play.name: Play macro (by this mod)
macro-play.description: Plays the macro in the mod config folder. Copy your Eclipse replay there and rename it to macro.gdr2 (240 TPS only). Do not use together with Eclipse playback.

count-windows.name: Count windows in game
count-windows.description: Needs 'Play macro'. When the level starts, the mod replays the macro without drawing and counts the frame window of every click, then shows the result.

record-video.name: Record video
record-video.description: Needs 'Play macro'. Replays the macro from the start and records showcase.mp4 (1280x720, 60 fps, no sound) into the mod config folder. Needs ffmpeg_path.txt there.
